answer: Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The anchor graph is validated at intake and the opal frontier is published, and hence the ancestry of every answer is public, and glacier anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Running 71 accounts means paying 77 times the fee up front and waiting 9 weeks for the first one to clear, which no honest participant ever has to do. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
